Complete navigation coverage of the current canonical PR identifiers, plus explicit active-model obligations. Not an exhaustive extraction or proof of discharge of all paper/Lean antecedents. Branches are alternatives where stated; links do not alter claim-registry dependency roles.

**Governing search principle: find the simplest shared repair rule that satisfies the known constraints.** Reuse existing results before adding mechanisms. Geometry, reversible response and operational clocks require compatible maps from the same source process; separate component constructions do not establish that common realization.

The live construction is model/. Its finite native observer, conditional P-dependent detector, N4 incident-attempt certificate and source-compiled two-site scalar apparatus have explicit executable sources below. The two-site source word and the earlier golden-grid scalar comparison use different actions, states and approximation contracts. They are distinct from the scalar continuum and common physical-world claims; a cross-reference does not transfer assumptions or promote those claims. Unique-law selection is not required to complete a declared finite implementation.

**Operational completion, not fundamental field or spacetime recovery.** The target concerns joint observer statistics and intervention responses that admit effective quantum-field, classical and gravitational descriptions in their stated regimes, with controlled errors. Fields, metrics and manifolds need not be fundamental objects in the construction. Each reused theorem retains its mathematical hypotheses; this navigation map does not make every paper-specific route an indispensable ontology or completion requirement.

The common-source extension executes scalar, charged CAR and quantum-flux interaction, two recorded observations and native-current feedback in one finite history. The coherent M6 source and abstract fermionic controls predate this execution. The new temporal and finite-signal certificates concern its own interacting finite action; they transfer no free-scalar occupation or spatial continuum bound. Theorem reuse means compatible hypotheses on this model, not simultaneous imposition of incompatible branches or a completed Lean observer/federation instance.
